nota: Gabarito tirado do código (grep e leitura), nunca do mapa. 'deve' = arquivos que a resposta precisa citar; 'aceita' = arquivos que podem aparecer sem contar como erro. Caminhos relativos à raiz do repositório.

tarefas.pergunta: Behind a reverse proxy, the application sees the proxy's address instead of the end user's. Which non-test source files in this repository derive the client IP address from request headers?
A handler panics in production and the server must keep serving. Which non-test source file catches the panic and prints the formatted stack trace?
A route is registered only for GET and a client sends POST to the same path. Which non-test source files decide that the answer is 405 Method Not Allowed and fill the Allow response header?
We want routing to accept a custom HTTP method such as QUERY. Which non-test source files define the set of known methods and let callers register a new one?
Every request should carry an identifier that also appears in the access log line. Which non-test source files generate that identifier and which one writes it into the log line?
List the non-test source files on the path from an incoming HTTP request to the matched handler: dispatch, the route tree lookup, and where URL parameters are stored for the handler to read.
In browsers, the XSRF token header is sometimes not sent. Which source files under lib/ read the XSRF cookie, decide whether the request is same-origin, and set the header?
Which source files under lib/ store request and response interceptors and run them in order around the request?
Which source file under lib/ chooses between the XMLHttpRequest, http and fetch transports for a request, and which files call it?
Upload progress events report a wrong transfer rate (bytes per second). Which source files under lib/ build the progress event object and compute that rate?
In Node.js, requests ignore the NO_PROXY environment variable. Which source files under lib/ read the proxy settings and decide whether a host bypasses the proxy?
A request timeout must surface as an AxiosError. Which source files under lib/ turn an expired timeout into that error in Node.js, with XMLHttpRequest, and with the fetch transport?
If the routing context type and its accessors in context.go changed their exported API, which other non-test source files use them and would need review? List every such file.
Which non-test middleware files change the request path or the routing path before the router matches the route? List every such file.
If the public API of the AxiosHeaders class changed, which other source files under lib/ use it and would need review? List every such file.

If the AxiosError constructor signature changed, which source files under lib/ construct AxiosError instances (new AxiosError, AxiosError.from, or a subclass calling super) and would need review? List every such file.
